use std::{
    fs::{self, OpenOptions},
    io::{Read, Write},
    os::unix::fs::FileTypeExt,
    process::{self, Command},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const FAULT: &str = FAULT_LITERAL;

fn home() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("HOME").unwrap().into()
}

pub fn log_process(role: &str, pid: u32) {
    let output = Command::new("/bin/ps")
        .args(["-o", "pgid=", "-p", &pid.to_string()])
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(output.status.success());
    let pgid: u32 = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
        .unwrap()
        .trim()
        .parse()
        .unwrap();
    let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open(home().join("processes.jsonl"))
        .unwrap();
    writeln!(
        file,
        "{}",
        serde_json::json!({"role": role, "pid": pid, "pgid": pgid})
    )
    .unwrap();
}

pub fn wait_ready(name: &str) {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(1);
    while !home().join(name).exists() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "synthetic child failed to start");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
    }
}

pub fn descendant() -> i32 {
    log_process("child", process::id());
    let mut child = Command::new("/bin/sleep").arg("20").spawn().unwrap();
    log_process("grandchild", child.id());
    fs::write(home().join("descendant-ready"), []).unwrap();
    child.wait().unwrap();
    0
}

pub fn check(input: &mut dyn Read, output: &mut dyn Write, error: &mut dyn Write) -> Option<i32> {
    log_process("checker", process::id());
    if FAULT == "dependency-failure" {
        return None;
    }
    Some(match FAULT {
        "pipe" => {
            let pipe = fs::metadata("/dev/stdin").unwrap().file_type().is_fifo();
            let mut bytes = Vec::new();
            input.read_to_end(&mut bytes).unwrap();
            let event: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
            writeln!(
                output,
                "{}",
                serde_json::json!({"event": event, "pipe": pipe})
            )
            .unwrap();
            0
        }
        "large-reason" | "large-stderr" => {
            let bytes = format!("{}\n", "x".repeat(131072));
            if FAULT == "large-stderr" {
                error.write_all(bytes.as_bytes())
            } else {
                output.write_all(bytes.as_bytes())
            }
            .unwrap();
            fs::write(home().join("producer-bytes"), bytes.len().to_string()).unwrap();
            2
        }
        "slow-reason" => {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(3200));
            writeln!(output, "DENIED: synthetic canary reason").unwrap();
            0
        }
        "no-reason" => 2,
        "checker-failure" => 7,
        "partial-panic" => {
            writeln!(output, "PARTIAL_RESULT_CANARY").unwrap();
            panic!("synthetic checker panic");
        }
        "panic" => panic!("synthetic checker panic"),
        "hang" | "runner-stall" | "early-failure" => {
            let mut child = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
                .arg("--test-descendant")
                .spawn()
                .unwrap();
            wait_ready("descendant-ready");
            fs::write(home().join("checker-ready"), []).unwrap();
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(20));
            child.wait().unwrap();
            0
        }
        "leftover" => {
            let child = Command::new("/bin/sleep").arg("20").spawn().unwrap();
            log_process("leftover", child.id());
            0
        }
        "late-start" | "startup-stall" => {
            fs::write(home().join("checker-ready"), []).unwrap();
            0
        }
        _ => panic!("unknown test fault"),
    })
}
